paper_metadata.title: A high-strength self-propagating-brazed Al0.1CoCrFeNi joint at high temperatures with nano-multilayer foils composed of Ni/Al-Al-FeCo/CrNi filler metal

evidence.quote: Novel nano-multilayer foils composed of Ni/Al-Al-FeCo/CrNi filler metals were developed for brazing Al0.1CoCrFeNi alloys.
We developed a novel brazing method for joining Al0.1CoCrFeNi HEAs using a multilayer Ni/Al-Al-FeCo/CrNi filler metal.
Al0.1CoCrFeNi alloy was fabricated from Al, Co, Cr, Fe, and Ni with purity ≥ 99.99 % through arc-melting under the protection of an argon atmosphere and remelted at least four times for uniformity.
Al0.1CoCrFeNi alloy was fabricated from Al, Co, Cr, Fe, and Ni with purity ≥ 99.99 % through arc-melting under the protection of an argon atmosphere and remelted at least four times for uniformity.
Al0.1CoCrFeNi alloy was fabricated from Al, Co, Cr, Fe, and Ni with purity ≥ 99.99 % through arc-melting under the protection of an argon atmosphere and remelted at least four times for uniformity.
Al0.1CoCrFeNi alloy was fabricated from Al, Co, Cr, Fe, and Ni with purity ≥ 99.99 % through arc-melting under the protection of an argon atmosphere and remelted at least four times for uniformity.
Al0.1CoCrFeNi alloy was fabricated from Al, Co, Cr, Fe, and Ni with purity ≥ 99.99 % through arc-melting under the protection of an argon atmosphere and remelted at least four times for uniformity.
Self-preparation Al0.lCoCrFeNi alloy sheets were used as substrates and Al foil (20 μ m) was used as filler.
